description: Config-driven healthcare transcription workflow for doctor-patient conversations, clinical note drafting, patient summaries, follow-up checklist, and human approval.

subagents.name: Clinical Conversation Transcription Agent
subagents.input_summary: Transcribe doctor-patient audio and preserve the conversation as source text for review.

subagents.name: Clinical Conversation Intake Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract patient, provider, encounter, language, and conversation context from the transcript.

subagents.name: SOAP Note Draft Agent
subagents.input_summary: Generate a clinician-review SOAP note draft from the transcript only.

subagents.name: Patient-Friendly Summary Agent
subagents.input_summary: Generate a patient-friendly visit summary and questions to bring back to the care team.

subagents.name: Visit Follow-Up Checklist Agent
subagents.input_summary: Extract follow-up actions, orders discussed, patient tasks, and open questions.

subagents.name: After Visit Summary Agent
subagents.input_summary: Generate a patient-facing after visit summary with tests, referrals, warnings, preventive reminders, facility coordination, and follow-up plan.

subagents.name: Clinical Scribe Governance Agent
subagents.input_summary: Identify PHI, consent, uncertainty, clinician review needs, and safe-use guardrails.
